answer: Cross-Epoch Behavioural Continuity Check. Each identity's action graph is hashed per epoch; a new epoch admits only devices whose pairwise interaction trace matches prior topology within a tolerance, and mismatches place the identity at its historical nadir of trust, throttling throughput. An attacker must sustain costly real interactions across many epochs, like maintaining a sable coat through summer heat, to keep fresh clones past the island of first admission.
